after a clear to Katethong's back forehand corner, Katethong usually plays one of about 11 shots. Most pros mix between about 10. Most often: a clear to the opponent's back forehand corner (22%).

after a drop to the middle of Katethong's forehand side, Katethong usually plays one of about 10 shots. Most pros mix between about 8. Most often: a net shot to the opponent's front backhand corner (27%).
after a short serve, wherever it lands, Katethong usually plays one of about 10 shots. Most pros mix between about 8. Most often: a lob to the opponent's back forehand corner (20%).

positions.plain_base: Katethong usually waits about 4 m from the net, a little toward the forehand side. Most pros wait between 3½ m and 4½ m from the net.

xp.plain_note: We also tried to predict who wins a rally from the shots and positions while it is still going. It did not work: the model did no better than a coin flip. We say so instead of hiding it.
xp.caveat: Read this first: xP from shot and position data has no signal mid-rally in elite singles (holdout AUC 0.50 on strokes that did not end the rally). The same features reach AUC 0.79 only on final strokes, where the task is classifying how an already-decisive stroke ends (winner or error), not predicting a rally. Nothing in this section is a working expected-points model.
